mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.code, t.name, t.parent_id, t.node_type, t.leader_user_id, leader.name AS leader_name, t.display_order, t.active, t.weekly_report_target FROM teams t LEFT JOIN users leader ON leader.id = t.leader_user_id WHERE t.active = TRUE AND t.node_type = 'TEAM' ORDER BY t.display_order, t.name

WITH RECURSIVE org_tree AS ( SELECT id, code, name, parent_id, node_type, leader_user_id, display_order, active, weekly_report_target, 0 AS level, CAST(CONCAT(LPAD(display_order, 4, '0'), '-', LPAD(id, 6, '0')) AS CHAR(1000)) AS sort_path, CAST(name AS CHAR(1000)) AS path FROM teams WHERE active = TRUE AND parent_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT child.id, child.code, child.name, child.parent_id, child.node_type, child.leader_user_id, child.display_order, child.active, child.weekly_report_target, parent.level + 1 AS level, CAST(CONCAT(parent.sort_path, '.', LPAD(child.display_order, 4, '0'), '-', LPAD(child.id, 6, '0')) AS CHAR(1000)) AS sort_path, CAST(CONCAT(parent.path, ' > ', child.name) AS CHAR(1000)) AS path FROM teams child JOIN org_tree parent ON parent.id = child.parent_id WHERE child.active = TRUE ) SELECT org_tree.id, org_tree.code, org_tree.name, org_tree.parent_id, parent.name AS parent_name, org_tree.node_type, org_tree.leader_user_id, leader.name AS leader_name, org_tree.display_order, org_tree.level, org_tree.path, org_tree.active, org_tree.weekly_report_target FROM org_tree LEFT JOIN teams parent ON parent.id = org_tree.parent_id LEFT JOIN users leader ON leader.id = org_tree.leader_user_id ORDER BY org_tree.sort_path

WITH RECURSIVE ancestors AS ( SELECT id, code, name, parent_id, node_type, leader_user_id, display_order, active, 0 AS level FROM teams WHERE id = #{teamId} UNION ALL SELECT parent.id, parent.code, parent.name, parent.parent_id, parent.node_type, parent.leader_user_id, parent.display_order, parent.active, ancestors.level + 1 AS level FROM ancestors JOIN teams parent ON parent.id = ancestors.parent_id WHERE parent.active = TRUE ) SELECT ancestors.id, ancestors.code, ancestors.name, ancestors.parent_id, parent.name AS parent_name, ancestors.node_type, ancestors.leader_user_id, leader.name AS leader_name, ancestors.display_order, ancestors.level, ancestors.active FROM ancestors LEFT JOIN teams parent ON parent.id = ancestors.parent_id LEFT JOIN users leader ON leader.id = ancestors.leader_user_id ORDER BY ancestors.level

SELECT t.id, t.code, t.name, t.parent_id, t.node_type, t.leader_user_id, leader.name AS leader_name, t.display_order, t.active FROM teams t LEFT JOIN users leader ON leader.id = t.leader_user_id WHERE t.id = #{id}

SELECT t.id, t.code, t.name, t.parent_id, t.node_type, t.leader_user_id, leader.name AS leader_name, t.display_order, t.active FROM teams t LEFT JOIN users leader ON leader.id = t.leader_user_id WHERE t.leader_user_id = #{userId} AND t.node_type IN ('DIVISION', 'ROOT') AND t.active = TRUE ORDER BY FIELD(t.node_type, 'ROOT', 'DIVISION'), t.id LIMIT 1

SELECT t.id, t.code, t.name, t.parent_id, t.node_type, t.leader_user_id, leader.name AS leader_name, t.display_order, t.active FROM teams t LEFT JOIN users leader ON leader.id = t.leader_user_id WHERE t.code = #{code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_settings(setting_key, setting_value) VALUES(#{key}, #{value}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE setting_value = VALUES(setting_value)

INSERT INTO teams(code, name, parent_id, node_type, display_order) VALUES( #{code}, #{name}, #{parentId}, #{nodeType}, ( SELECT COALESCE(MAX(t.display_order), 0) + 1 FROM teams t WHERE COALESCE(t.parent_id, 0) = COALESCE(#{parentId}, 0) ) )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM teams WHERE parent_id = #{teamId} AND active = TRUE
mapper.update: UPDATE teams SET active = FALSE, leader_user_id = NULL WHERE id = #{teamId}
mapper.delete: DELETE ur FROM user_roles ur JOIN users u ON u.id = ur.user_id WHERE u.team_id = #{teamId} AND ur.role_code = 'TEAM_LEADER' AND (#{leaderUserId} IS NULL OR ur.user_id != #{leaderUserId})
